briefing._note: The single daily touch. v2 change control (build package Decision 1) moved it from a 20:00 check-in to a 07:30 morning briefing; the 20:00 send is retired, not supplemented. Exactly ONE outbound message per day remains a standing rule — changing it again needs change control, not a config edit.

fitness._note: The owner's real outlets. A MENU, never a calendar — nothing here is ever scheduled onto a date. dog-walk carries isFloor: it always counts, and the suggestion logic can never rank it out of reach.

nutrition._note: SnapCalorie descoped by owner 2026-09-10 (override of build-package Decision 10). Decision 10's own fallback clause applies: Claude's estimate, stored and echoed flagged as an estimate. Set engine to 'snapcalorie' and place a key to re-enable GOTK-156.

kroger._note: The app's ONLY external access, granted by build-package Decision 8 (change control 2026-09-26). Three public Kroger endpoints: Locations, Products search, and Cart ADD. Add-only by API design — there is no cart read, no removal and no checkout to call. Invoked only when the owner explicitly asks; never scheduled, never proactive. Setting enabled to false switches the whole handoff off and the shopping list stays a plain list.
kroger._locationId: The owner's King Soopers — Havana and Mississippi, 1155 S Havana St, Aurora CO 80012 (owner's choice, 2026-09-26). Re-find with: node bin/kroger-locations.js [zip]. If this is unset the handoff fails closed to the plain list rather than guessing a shop.

secrets._note: Paths only, never values. Every file is read at point of use by lib/secrets.js and the app fails closed without it.
secrets._krogerRefreshTokenPath: The one credential this app WRITES, so unlike the others it cannot live in root-only space. A bare filename resolves under dataDir (0700, service-owned, gitignored), which keeps each throwaway test instance on its own token instead of the live one.
